ex.en: The tourism industry is highly cyclical.
ex.zh: 觀光業具有高度的週期性。

ex.en: Cyclical unemployment rises during a recession.
ex.zh: 景氣衰退時，循環性失業會增加。

cyclical.en: happening in a repeated pattern over time

ex.en: Usually I cycle or get the bus to work.
ex.zh: 我通常騎腳踏車或搭公車上班。

ex.en: Most of the pupils here cycle to school.
ex.zh: 這裡大多數學生騎車上學。

ex.en: That young man is very keen on cycling.
ex.zh: 那個年輕人非常熱衷騎腳踏車。

ex.en: The product life cycle is getting shorter.
ex.zh: 產品生命週期越來越短。

ex.en: We review the budget in a three-month cycle.
ex.zh: 我們以三個月為週期檢討預算。

cycle.en: a series of events that happen again and again in the same order

ex.en: The fashion industry is highly cyclic.
ex.zh: 時尚產業具有高度循環性。

ex.en: Sales show a cyclic pattern every year.
ex.zh: 銷售每年都呈現週期性變化。

cyclic.en: happening in a repeated pattern over time

ex.en: The tower is shaped like a cylinder.
ex.zh: 這座塔的形狀像一個圓柱。

ex.en: Calculate the volume of the cylinder.
ex.zh: 算出這個圓柱的體積。

cylinder.en: a solid shape shaped like a tube with flat round ends

ex.en: The piston does not come into contact with the cylinder cover.
ex.zh: 活塞不會碰到汽缸蓋。

ex.en: The engine has six cylinders.
ex.zh: 這具引擎有六個汽缸。

cylinder.en: a tube-shaped part inside an engine where fuel is burned

cyclone.zh: 氣旋、熱帶氣旋（颶風、颱風）

ex.en: All flights were canceled because of the cyclone.
ex.zh: 所有航班都因為氣旋而取消。

ex.en: The cyclone caused serious damage to the coast.
ex.zh: 這個氣旋對沿海地區造成嚴重損害。

cyclone.en: a very strong wind storm that spins around a center

ex.en: He has become cynical about politics after so many broken promises.
ex.zh: 在那麼多承諾落空之後，他對政治變得憤世嫉俗。

ex.en: Don't be so cynical; some people really do want to help.
ex.zh: 別那麼憤世嫉俗，有些人真的是想幫忙。

ex.en: The cyclist stopped at the red light and waited.
ex.zh: 那位騎自行車的人在紅燈前停下來等待。

ex.en: Many cyclists ride along the river on weekends.
ex.zh: 許多騎車的人週末會沿著河邊騎。

ex.en: Cyprus is an island country in the Mediterranean Sea.
ex.zh: 塞普勒斯是地中海上的一個島國。

ex.en: Many tourists visit Cyprus for its warm weather and beaches.
ex.zh: 許多遊客因為塞普勒斯溫暖的天氣和海灘而前往旅遊。

ex.en: Cycling to work is a good way to stay healthy.
ex.zh: 騎腳踏車上班是保持健康的好方法。

ex.en: Cycling is very popular along the river in my town.
ex.zh: 在我住的小鎮，沿著河邊騎自行車很受歡迎。

cynicism.zh: 憤世嫉俗；懷疑一切的態度

ex.en: Years of broken promises led to growing cynicism among voters.
ex.zh: 多年的跳票使選民越來越憤世嫉俗。

ex.en: She looked at his offer with cynicism.
ex.zh: 她帶著懷疑的態度看待他的提議。

ex.en: A row of tall cypress trees lined the road.
ex.zh: 一排高大的柏樹沿著道路兩旁而立。

ex.en: The garden smelled of cypress after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨後花園裡瀰漫著柏樹的香氣。

ex.en: My uncle is a cynic who trusts no politician.
ex.zh: 我叔叔是個憤世嫉俗的人，不相信任何政客。

ex.en: Even the biggest cynic smiled at the happy ending.
ex.zh: 就連最憤世嫉俗的人看到圓滿結局也笑了。

ex.en: The water tank was a large cylindrical container made of steel.
ex.zh: 那個水槽是鋼製的大型圓柱形容器。

ex.en: She stored the posters in a cylindrical tube to keep them flat.
ex.zh: 她把海報收在圓筒裡，避免折損。

ex.en: The doctor found a small cyst on her wrist.
ex.zh: 醫生在她的手腕上發現一個小囊腫。

ex.en: Most cysts are harmless and go away by themselves.
ex.zh: 大多數囊腫是無害的，會自己消失。

ex.en: We had a delicious Cypriot salad by the sea.
ex.zh: 我們在海邊吃了一份美味的塞普勒斯沙拉。

ex.en: Cypriot cuisine mixes Greek and Turkish traditions.
ex.zh: 塞普勒斯菜結合了希臘與土耳其的傳統。

ex.en: A Cypriot taught us a few words of Greek.
ex.zh: 一位塞普勒斯人教了我們幾個希臘語單字。

ex.en: The Cypriot we met on the trip was very friendly.
ex.zh: 我們旅行中遇到的那位塞普勒斯人非常友善。

ex.en: She was treated for cystic acne last year.
ex.zh: 她去年因為囊腫型痘痘接受了治療。

ex.en: The scan showed a cystic mass in the kidney.
ex.zh: 掃描顯示腎臟有一個囊性腫塊。

ex.en: Cyanide is a deadly poison.
ex.zh: 氰化物是劇毒物質。

ex.en: The detective novel is about a man who was killed with cyanide.
ex.zh: 這本偵探小說是關於一名被氰化物毒死的男子。

cynically.zh: 憤世嫉俗地、冷嘲熱諷地

ex.en: He smiled cynically and said nobody really cared.
ex.zh: 他冷笑著說，其實沒有人真的在乎。

ex.en: She cynically assumed the offer was a trick.
ex.zh: 她憤世嫉俗地認為這個提議是個圈套。
